## Unconditional full dense two-target estimate for arbitrary effective sources

Stable ID: p1:internal:unconditional-dense-two-target-mass. The canonical theorem retains arbitrary W and only the printed W/target disjointness. Fresh regularization follows exact unit erasure, and all former geometric uses in this particular lemma are discharged; general geometric properties remain separate.

Main Lemma15.2 now has unconditional canonical proofs of both printed assertions. UnconditionalDenseTwoTargetMass.article_15_2 gives the full nonaligned-or-weakly-aligned estimate, with the explicit positive threshold theta=eta/64, simultaneously for actual heterogeneous marginals, homogeneous effective singleton probabilities and literal nominal2^(-L) weights. One threshold precedes every critical length, every collection of s actual source windows, every effective subspace W of their full value span and every target population. The only source/target directness assumptions are W cap S_y=W cap S_z=0. Source windows may overlap or be dependent, and W may be a proper diagonal subspace. The original statement and proof at main_sections/exact_transfer.tex lines129-168 were compared with these exact quantifiers and weights.

DenseTwoTargetWeakHosts completes the arbitrary-W weak-alignment branch. The exact target intersection cap is(eta/64)*L on every actual enlarged alignment channel. Erasing all canonical target/target unit endpoints costs at most2*(eta/64)*L+4 dimensions. Together with the checked effective physical lift, at leasteta*L/2 dimensions survive onceeta*L>=32. Both target projections remain injective. Active target/target nonalignment follows from the internally proved fixed-four-position obstruction, even when the active populations themselves have arbitrary size.

Each target is then treated by the deterministic aligned-source-pool alternative established at checkpoint428. A target aligned with one of the fixed old sources has subpower many possibilities. A target outside that pool has global nonalignment with every old source and active nonalignment with the other target, so DensePhysicalAnchorWitness applies. It constructs a fresh recovery regularization after exact block-index transport, inside the erased subspace. Recovery exclusion is never assumed to survive coordinate erasure. No disjointness from each old source is inferred merely from W-disjointness.

The complete admissible target population has the stronger host boundN^epsilon, in both rank strata. Combining this count with the exact effective rank capd<=L proves each of the three weighted estimates atN^(-1+epsilon). Zero actual marginals, local defects, incompatible affine systems, actual window values and all ordered pair multiplicities are retained. The estimate even permits a larger target population than the printed fresh distinct pairs; restricting to the printed population is immediate.

RestrictedDensePrimitiveMass proves the second assertion for every fixed source size s>=1 and every real prescribed-source exponent sigma, with the exact finite source pool, containment cover and dense primitive population. Its actual and nominal conclusions are mass<=N^(-1-s+sigma+epsilon). For sigma>=0 the stronger full dense primitive estimate from checkpoint427 suffices. For sigma<0 the finite prescribed source pool, and hence every covered family population, is empty onceN>=3. No nonnegativity restriction on sigma is added.

All former coefficient-enumeration, chosen-source/ordinary surface-cover and normalized-curve uses are discharged for canonical main15.2. This does not establish those general geometric properties or the separate sharp growing-degree BCN theorem. The original manuscript bytes and earlier conditional proof history remain preserved.

## Finite Rolle zero populations and a recursive Chebyshev criterion

Stable ID: p1:internal:finite-rolle-recursive-chebyshev. Finite Rolle and recursive normalized-pivot zero counts are internal. Classical partial-Wronskian, curve-piece and smooth-parametrization bridges remain open.

The finite zero-counting core for the real-analytic BCN route is now internally proved. FiniteRolleZeros constructs one actual derivative zero in every gap between consecutive points of any given finite zero population inside an open real interval. The construction uses the increasing finite enumeration and Rolle theorem, proves the constructed derivative zeros are distinct and retains their interval membership. It needs only continuity of the original function on that interval. There is no assumed finiteness or cardinality bound for the whole zero set.

The finite derivative inequality and its iteration are proved separately. A boundk on all finite derivative-zero populations yields at mostk+1 original zeros. If every iterated derivative through ordern is continuous and the actualnth derivative is nowhere zero, every finite original zero population has cardinality at mostn. The casesn=0, empty populations and arbitrary open intervals are included.

RecursiveChebyshev gives a concrete recursive pivot criterion. For an actual finite family, divide its tail by the first function and differentiate. Admissible requires differentiability of the current functions, nonvanishing of the current first function, and the same conditions on the smaller normalized derivative family. These are actual regularity and pivot properties; no zero-count estimate is a field or premise. The normalized finite-sum identity and its actual derivative are proved, with all nonvanishing divisions and interval restrictions explicit. Induction using the finite Rolle construction proves every combination with nonzero coefficient vector has fewer zeros than the family size. Evaluation at any sufficiently large actual finite set is therefore injective, and vanishing there forces every coefficient to be zero.

This is a preparatory recursive-pivot form, not yet the classical partial-Wronskian criterion used in BCN. The determinant identities connecting those pivots to the actual partial Wronskians, their nonvanishing on geometric curve pieces, the bounded number of such pieces, smooth parametrizations and the final sharp point count remain subsequent obligations. No new proof ofBCN, full main13.4 or original13.5 is claimed. The current generic plane theorem remains the internally proved cubic degree estimate, with fulla<1/3 growing range. The complete main optimal scalar laws and unconditional dense graph clause ofT1.7 remain unchanged.

The primary BCN author version arXiv2302.04209v2, Sections2-5, was read directly to identify this outstanding real-analytic route. Its theorem is not used as an axiom or a proved input. PolynomialTangentTrajectory defines the actual polynomial vector field(P_y,-P_x) and its componentwise ordinary differential equation on an open real set. The equation itself impliesC-infinity regularity: start from the continuous coordinate functions supplied by their derivatives, then bootstrap each finite order using smooth polynomial evaluation of the velocity. Smoothness is not an extra trajectory hypothesis. Along every such actual trajectory, the real derivative ofQ equals the evaluation ofL_P(Q). Restriction preserves this local property, and the first family function is nonzero at some point of every nonempty interval. RationalTangentNumerator constructs the exact polynomial quotient recurrence for the normalized graph operator L_x = partial_x - (P_x/P_y) partial_y. Index n corresponds to derivative order n+1 and denominator P_y^(2n+1). Its recurrence is N_next = P_y L_P(N) - e N L_P(P_y), where L_P = P_y partial_x - P_x partial_y and e=2n+1. The expanded mixed term has a minus sign. The construction works over any commutative ring, and its actual polynomial numerator has total degree at most deg(Q)+2 deg(P)(n+1). No nonzero numerator is presumed.

It proves the actual evaluation chain rule and constancy of the curve equation. IteratedGraphDerivative verifies the quotient differentiation algebra, the derivative of every numerator quotient, the complete open-chart iterated derivative identity, and the positive-order statement: for every j>=1 there is an actual polynomial N of degree at most deg(Q)+2 deg(P)j such that the j-th real derivative of Q along the chart is N/P_y^(2j-1). These are ordinary real derivatives of the actual functions, not supplied derivative identities. No existence of such a normalized chart is asserted by this checkpoint.

The primary author version of Binyamini--Cluckers--Novikov, arXiv:2302.04209v2, Section 4 Proposition 8, equation (21), was checked both in the official PDF and official HTML. Its displayed expanded recurrence has a plus sign in the P_y P_x partial_y(N) term, whereas the stated L_x definition and quotient rule require a minus sign. A kernel-checked polynomial counterexample uses P=x+y+xy, Q=y and the curve point (0,0), where P_y=1: the corrected second numerator evaluates to 2, while the displayed plus-sign expression evaluates to 0. This is recorded in docs/LITERATURE_ERRATA.md as a separate external-reference erratum. It is not a third false P1 statement or a claim that BCN's theorem is false. The corrected recurrence retains the stated degree allowance.

HomogeneousDilation constructs an actual coefficient-algebra endomorphism in every genuinely graded commutative coefficient algebra. GradedVeroneseDilation takes k=D-1 for D>0 and a genuine degree-one coordinate b. Its literal image belongs to the actual Dth Veronese subalgebra, with a source-degree-n element mapping into genuine Veronese degree n and underlying original degree n*D. GradedVeroneseDilationChart proves that the actual induced normalized homogeneous-chart map is bijective, including in rings with zero divisors. Existing actual chart-localization theorems then give bijectivity of the full localized ring map as well. No chart equivalence is an input.

GradedVeroneseChartPrimeHeight proves that a homogeneous prime avoiding b is recovered exactly by pulling its Veronese contraction back along the dilation. The actual localized-ring bijection therefore proves that this prime and its literal contraction to every positive Dth Veronese have exactly equal heights. This theorem applies to arbitrary genuinely graded commutative coefficient algebras and does not require the ambient algebra to be a domain or normal.

OrdinaryCurveVeroneseHeight constructs the actual prime of the ordinary radical-surface quotient defined by a given ordinary curve ideal, proves its homogeneity and chart avoidance, identifies each actual auxiliary-degree surface ideal with its literal Veronese contraction, and applies the general height theorem. Thus the actual ordinary surface-curve height is independent of every positive auxiliary Veronese degree. Its source_curve_at_degree theorem upgrades the actual source-to-ordinary curve construction: a source curve at its chosen embedding E produces an actual ordinary image curve at arbitrary positive auxiliary D, with the fixed literal image ideal and genuine bounds d <= E_source <= E*d. There is no restriction relating auxiliary D to the sizes of the radical equations.

## Coefficient-uniform coarse finite-field surface class count including identically zero reductions

Stable ID: p1:internal:coarse-canonical-surface-class-count. The actual canonical classes have an unconditional coarse d*p^2 bound at every prime. This does not discharge the sharper global auxiliary input.

LinearPolynomialSubstitutionDegree proves that substitution of actual multivariate polynomials of degree at most one cannot increase total degree, even with a coefficient ring homomorphism. IntegerPolynomialReduction proves that coefficient maps commute with actual polynomial evaluation and identifies coefficient reduction of the original last-coordinate affine chart with the literal linear substitution into the original homogeneous equation.

FiniteFieldSurfaceZeroBound applies the proved Schwartz-Zippel theorem to actual three-coordinate polynomial zeros over an arbitrary finite field. For every nonzero equation Q and every actual finite set S of its zeros it proves card(S)<=totalDegree(Q)*card(F)^2. The normalization of the three-variable denominator and all real-free cardinality conversions are internal.

P3CoarseCanonicalClassCount maps the actual canonical classes injectively to their three finite-field coordinates. It proves exact compatibility between evaluation of the reduced affine equation and the original integer representative. For a homogeneous degree-d original equation it proves the reduced affine equation has total degree at most d. If that reduced equation is nonzero, the actual class image lies in its actual zero set and Schwartz-Zippel yields card(Class p P)<=d*p^2.

The identically zero reduction is handled separately and does not require a good-prime hypothesis. A canonical class would have an actual derivative not divisible by p; Euler's identity supplies such a derivative in one of the three free coordinates without dividing by d. Coefficient reduction commutes with this derivative. An identically zero reduced affine equation has all those derivatives zero, contradicting the actual class property. Thus there are no canonical smooth classes in this case. The final card(Class p P)<=d*p^2 holds for EVERY prime, every homogeneous integer equation, every coefficient content and every degree, without assuming geometric irreducibility or a supplied nonzero reduction.
